scenicChapters.title: Apache Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 38 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Apache Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: For 13 km this is Apache Trail, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

apache-trail.story: A one-way ride of 109 km, Apache Junction to the finish - roughly 1 h 28 in the saddle. The stops in between: Canyon Lake, Tortilla Flat and Fish Creek Hill. The highest point is about 1,350 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
